alerts.description: From Nov. 1 to March 31, 2027, the interior trails of Back Bay National Wildlife Refuge are closed. Access to False Cape during this time is restricted to the beach. The Visitor Center will also be closed Monday through Wednesday during this time.

alerts.title: ROAD CLOSURE: Camp Paradise Road will be closed for paving operations on Thursday,…
alerts.description: ROAD CLOSURE: Camp Paradise Road will be closed for paving operations on Thursday, November 19 and Friday, November 20. Vehicular access to High Bridge Station(Visitor Center)will resume on Saturday, November 21. BRIDGE REPAIRS: The River Road bridge in Farmville, that connects the downtown section of trail to the High Bridge, will be rebuilt. This will close the trail from Main Street heading east to Osborne Road through November.

alerts.description: All boat ramps and the fuel dock are closed due to falling lake levels. Marina slip renters are able to enter the park to retrieve their boat, but will not be able to use the ramps. Please contact the park office with any questions. Click here for a list with the status of US Army Corps of Engineers boat ramps on Kerr Reservoir.

alerts.title: There will be managed deer hunts at the park on Nov. 9, Nov. 10, Dec. 7 and Dec. 8.
